Tasks.Title: My tasks
Tasks.Intro: Decisions automations are waiting for from you: assigned to you, your roles and groups, or passed to you.

Empty.MineHint: When an automation asks you, your role or your group to decide, the task appears here and you get a notification.
Empty.OverdueHint: Open tasks past their due time appear here.
Empty.Decided: You have not decided any task yet
Empty.DecidedHint: Tasks you decide stay here, with how they ended.

Closed.Expired: The due time passed: the task closed without a decision
Closed.Cancelled: The automation was stopped: the task is cancelled
Closed.Changed: The task changed while you were deciding. Here is how it stands now.

Comment.Label: Comment
Comment.Hint: Visible to the automation and the other assignees.
Comment.Missing: Write a comment: this decision needs one.

Confirm.Label: Confirm {{.Outcome}}

Confirm.Hint: The decision cannot be changed once it is recorded.

Tasks.Slow: Still waiting for the server. The decision will not be recorded twice.

Form.UnavailableHint: This task is decided with a form this application does not have. Ask the automation's owner to fix the step; until then it cannot be decided here.

Missing.Title: This task is not available
Missing.Hint: It was assigned to someone else, passed on, or you are no longer among its assignees.

Errors.Invalid: Check the decision: a required comment or field is missing or wrong.
